name: Sankaty Head Golf Club
architects: H. Emerson Armstrong (1923); restoration by Jim Urbina (c. 2019-2020)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project MA_NE_CMGP_Sandy_Z19_2013 (post-Sandy coastal lidar, 2013), tiles x41y457 and x41y458 mosaicked and cut to the world + 100 m by data/sankaty_head/make_dem.py; EPSG:26919 (NAD83 / UTM 19N), NAVD88 metres; fetched through the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-sankaty_head)

ortho.source: USDA NAIP via the USGS National Map ImageServer (USGSNAIPImagery, 0.3 m service resolution, mostly 0.6 m imagery), four JPEG exports in EPSG:32619 fetched through the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31, placed by their request boxes and mosaicked by pipeline/intake.py ortho; flight year not stated by the service

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 295320135) bbox 754 x 1,730 m in UTM 19N + scenery, whole 256 m chunks, centred: 1,024 m east-west (135 m west and east), 2,048 m north-south (the 2,048 m limit: 159 m south and north)

scorecard_source: GolfPass scorecard (golfpass.com/courses/7253-sankaty-head-golf-club/scorecard-and-layout), read 2026-10-31: seven tee columns per hole (Champ., Black, White, White/Blue, Blue, Yellow, Family), par 71, men's handicap row; rows add up (Championship 6,730, Blue 5,525). GolfLink (golflink.com) has the same per-hole yardages and calls the 6,730 row Black (72.6/126) and Blue 5,525 67.2/118; GolfPass's tee table gives Black 6,625 72.6/126 and Blue 5,580 67.2/118. Unverified; no club card online (private club). Built: the tips (Championship) and Blue (developer, 2026-10-30: back tees and Blue; Blue the default).
attribution: Elevation and lidar: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program
Imagery: USDA NAIP via the USGS National Map
notes: Course chat, 2026-10-31 (developer asleep, overnight calls): standing defaults (every penalty area red, OSM boundary as OB, trees from lidar, fairway trees removed), wind 3-14 (open coast), tees Championship + Blue (Blue default).

laz.source: NOAA Digital Coast dataset 9551, 2018 USGS Lidar: Nantucket (MA2018 Nantucket), flown 1-2 May 2018; 28 COPC tiles (about 387 m) on the noaa-nos-coastal-lidar-pds S3 bucket, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow (release data-sankaty_head), clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py laz --classes 1 (the project has only 1 unclassified, 2 ground, 7/9/10: no vegetation classes); NAD83(2011) / UTM 19N, NAVD88 m
laz.label: 2018 USGS Nantucket lidar

range_art_note: the practice ground east of the clubhouse is out of bounds (standing default); NAIP shows mostly blond rough with one mown hitting strip, so it is drawn as rough with OB stakes rather than striped fairway (as at Oregon Golf Club and Meadow Club)
